task.description:
REWORK ITERATION 1: Previous Step 2a attempt failed the SECURITY-REVIEWER hard gate (Step 2c) with two BLOCKERs and one MAJOR. Fix the following on branch feature/WF02-prm02-05-20260816, then re-apply your original Step 2a acceptance criteria (zig build check exit 0; migration applies; PRM-02..05 ACs).

BLOCKER 1 (INV-1 — tenant data isolation): migration 096_promotion_reviews.sql creates promotion_reviews with no scope guard and the table is absent from BUSINESS_TABLES in tools/lint_migration_schema.py; the table exists only in public with 0 RLS policies and no per-tenant copies. The submit/context/approve/reject/apply paths operate on a shared un-scoped table under LEGACY_RLS-mode tenants / no-tenant path — cross-tenant read/write of promotion diffs and review metadata. Fix: make promotion_reviews tenant-isolated per the repo's per-tenant migration pattern (tenant-scoped migration + per-tenant table provisioning), and add it to BUSINESS_TABLES so lint_migration_schema.py tracks it.

BLOCKER 2 (INV-2 — server-side field authorisation): handleApproveReview/handleApplyReview/handleGetPromotionContext discard the authenticated principal (_ = actor) and take approved_by from the request body; the self-approval gate compares two client-supplied values, so any authenticated caller who can read a review_id can approve it by supplying any approved_by != requested_by (even a fabricated UUID), and the DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED event records that client-supplied identity. Fix: derive approved_by (and the event actor_id) from the authenticated actor server-side; never trust request-body identity.

MAJOR (INV-1/INV-6 — consistency): DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED is written under the target-tenant search_path while DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED/_APPLIED are written under the request principal's context; submitReview inserts the row under the caller's schema while stamping tenant_id = target_tenant_id. Fix: make one explicit owner-tenant decision, enforced identically on every promotion path.

Read the Step 2c handoff result and the security invariants doc for full citations. After fixing, run zig build check, re-apply migrations to the test DB, and confirm the security findings are resolved.
acceptance_criteria: promotion_reviews tenant-isolated (per-tenant provisioning + added to BUSINESS_TABLES in tools/lint_migration_schema.py)
Approver identity derived from authenticated actor server-side; no client-supplied approved_by
Single owner-tenant decision enforced on every promotion event path
Migration applies cleanly to the test DB
Original PRM-02..05 acceptance criteria still met

result.summary: Rework 1 cleared the Step 2c security gate findings on PRM-02..05. INV-1 BLOCKER: promotion_reviews is now tenant-isolated — migration 096 is -- scope: tenant_only (per-tenant provisioning only), GBL-143 drops the historical public shadow, and promotion_reviews was added to BUSINESS_TABLES in tools/lint_migration_schema.py and to the TNT runtime isolation list (21->22). INV-2 BLOCKER: handleApproveReview no longer accepts approved_by from the request body; the approver and the DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED event actor are the authenticated actor (actor.user_id); any extra body field returns 422 UNKNOWN_FIELD. MAJOR: single owner-tenant decision (the review row's tenant_id = target tenant) enforced on every promotion path — submitReview inserts under the target schema, and approve/reject/apply/fail/supersede switch to the review's owner tenant before DB work, so DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED/_APPROVED/_APPLIED all land under the same owner; markReviewApplied records the applying principal as event actor. Verified: zig build check exit 0, lint_migration_schema 0 violations, lint_sql_table_refs/lint_sql_param_types clean, migrations applied to bpm_test (public shadow dropped; 096 applied to tenant_default), test-integration-tnt exit 0 with the 22-table isolation list.

issues.description: Design drift: src/design/prm02-05-promotion-approval-pipeline.md PRM-05 documents approve body {plan_digest, approved_by}; INV-2 requires the approver be the authenticated actor, so the implementation accepts {plan_digest} only and rejects approved_by with 422 UNKNOWN_FIELD. CODE-DESIGNER to reconcile the design doc.

TEST-DESIGNER: review transition signatures changed — approveReview/rejectReview/markReviewApplied/markReviewFailed/supersedeReview now take the review's owner tenant_id (markReviewApplied also actor_id) before expected_row_version. The acknowledged-broken PRM-02..05 integration tests must be rewritten against the new contracts.

Pre-existing, out of scope: promotion_assertion_runs (1156) conditional FK to promotion_reviews was skipped at its apply time (096 absent); the FK is now missing in tenant_default despite 096 being present. Both tables are co-located in the tenant schema — no isolation impact; PRM-06 wiring may want to re-apply the FK.
